title: AI Stocks Are CRASHING — Don't Miss This Opportunity
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Mark Roussin argues the AI sell-off — some names down 20–50% from recent highs — is sentiment and fear, not a collapse in AI spending, since the underlying businesses are still growing revenue 40–100%+ with orders growing faster. On Nvidia: Huang is gone, the board is not considering a return, and Tuesday's earnings will be fantastic but shares will not trade on results. He reveals he sold some of his Nvidia last week, not because it is expensive — its valuation is 'extremely interesting' — but because of the major cloud of uncertainty and he dislikes capital tied up in distracted companies. He then pitches three names. AMD (~$504, ~25% off its $650+ high) is his highest-conviction growth stock: Anthropic ported Claude to AMD MI355 GPUs in 3 days versus 6–12 months normally, EPS is expected to double next year, forward P/E ~30x, PEG below 1, analyst average target ~$660. Bloom Energy (~$177, ~50% off its high) grew revenue ~140% to ~$1.2bn and raised guidance a third time, but free cash flow and operating profitability are concerns — keep it high on the watch list. Vertiv (~$189, ~50% off its ~$380 high) grew revenue 61% to ~$4.3bn, operating profit 83%, EPS 78%, organic orders over 100%, guidance raised, forward P/E ~20x, PEG below 1, analyst target ~$335. Calls: AMD BUY reiterated, NVDA SELL (flip from BUY 12 Nov — partial trim), BE UNCERTAIN (first tracked Roussin mention), VRT BUY reiterated. Note: captions garble several names (Anthropic/Enthropic, Vertiv/Verdive, Huang/Wong).
